Abhijeet Dipke faces IT panel; NEET paper leak controversy escalates

Abhijeet Dipke, founder of CJP, is scheduled to appear before a Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) review committee regarding the blocking of his X (formerly Twitter) account. This development coincides with escalating controversy surrounding the NEET exam paper leak, with Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan taking responsibility for student suicides linked to the leak and facing criticism from opposition leaders. Separately, a paper leak in Maharashtra's TET exam has led to an SIT probe and postponement of the exam.
